name: description-list
description: Term/value pairs on a semantic `<dl>`: `DescriptionList` > `DescriptionItem` > `DescriptionTerm` + `DescriptionDetails`. `layout="inline"` (default) puts each value at the end of its row, right-aligned with tabular numbers — for order summaries, totals and plan details; `layout="stacked"` puts the value under a smaller term, in a grid whose columns you set with `className` — for record details. `divided` draws rules between rows. An icon inside `DescriptionTerm` sits before the label.
